params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sv_count, MIN(NumPlaces) AS min_places, MIN(NumObservations) AS min_obs, MIN(CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER)) AS latest_date FROM stats WHERE StatVar = 'Count_CriminalActivities'
params.condition: sv_count = 1 AND min_places >= 35 AND min_obs >= 800 AND latest_date >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 2
